summary: The complete repository gate exited 0 on candidate 4a9c with unchanged executable source files during the run; this does not close the separate physical and native experience failures. Current 4a9c also fixes a retained real export-card language failure. The 2aab city batch repair preserves original budgets, per-instance equivalence and three actual rebakes; its three native images are captured and reviewed, with requested driving dwell still partial. Earlier six matched city pairs and all controls retain their actual stages. X completion has post-receipt physical observation; manual W→E+1 and severe-step physics still fail. Shadow native night A/B is partial, H-only native chains have no per-step journal, and user-GPU acceptance is untested. Previous failed regression attempts remain intact.
scope: Per-topic acceptance assembly. Every native recording retains its actual loaded build (26692 / 5b9 / f841 / c080 / 29f7 / a347 / 2aab); 4a9c is the local candidate after the export-card language repaint. Static form, numerical solver, native UI, continuous motion and hardware-GPU scopes remain separate.
purpose: Evidence assembly, not a new validation runner. No score or assertion count substitutes for user experience acceptance.

repositoryGate.previousFailureScope: Attempt 9 exited 1 on an exact bake dependency whitelist that omitted the newly used dist/street-display.js; it was not interrupted and did not fail a source hash comparison. repositoryGate.interpretation: The repository gate is complete on unchanged sources. Numerical contracts may explicitly retain counterexamples as known failures; exit 0 does not change those failures, fill absent native journals or accept hardware-GPU experience.

implementation: X landing uses actual wheel support / suspension / rigid contact and a sustained completion handoff; no forced chassis attitude.
DRIVE does not enter flight assistance from collision or tilt. Control owner, requested force and valve residual are displayed separately.
G is level attitude, heading / captured-height assistance and horizontal damping, without a world-XZ position lock; explicit H/E and X/U/L keep their declared owners.
Entering H while moving waits for braking before sampling a stationary position; old XZ targets and controller residuals are cleared or recaptured at declared transitions.
Preheld Q cannot bypass X four-wheel completion; research hold exits through H, suction and reset do not implicitly enable G.

nativeLimitations: The f841 G chain and c080 focused moving-X run share byte-identical controller sources. The final a347 build adds separately tested entry/hold-exit guards; earlier recordings keep their actual identity.

The original 3.17 end screenshot pause selector was hidden and timed out after continuous observation. Its failure report, unpaused screenshot and video are preserved; this does not erase the recorded persistent LAND result.
Playwright generated native browser keyboard events under SwiftShader. This is not physical keyboard or user-GPU acceptance.
Native sampling/UI round trips mean requested dwell lengths and actually received simultaneous-input duration differ; both are retained.
All local runs requested the optional deployment.json and received HTTP 404; no pageerror exception was captured.

The existing production input journal arms physics-step tracing only on X/U/G/E/Q/1/2. H/W/research-capture-only chains retain native key events, complete telemetry checkpoints and continuous video, but no 120 Hz journal. Empty journals are not treated as every-step passes. The numerical entry-guard tests separately retain every physical step.

limits: Million-newton normal peaks and severe 90 km/h trajectory convergence are unresolved.
The unchanged faceted rigid wheel stops and compliant crown support are different modelling approximations; tested crown replacement did not justify merging it.
Exact duplicate contact-point accounting does not prove every near-coincident manifold point is physically appropriate.
Impulse-work closure isolates the constraint solve; it is not a complete deformable tyre or damage energy model.

limits: Native W/A/D, mouse orbit and C acted on continuous application state; no hidden pose/step setters were used.
Complete laboratory protocols and bounded city protocols are separate from pixel stability acceptance.
The old low-rate native observations cannot expose all high-display-rate scheduler mismatch; retained 120 Hz actual-matrix reproduction is the evidence for that fault.
Different actual steering/physics/camera timing and revised vehicle/city geometry prevent registered pixel differencing from these native recordings.
The reported motion/depth update flags are application telemetry, not atomic GPU framebuffer readback.
Normal maps, receiver-plane correction and real shadows remain; finite resolution, bias, filtering and cascade aliasing need separate visual observation.
The original user-installed build and the user GPU remain unverified.
The first laboratory reports and first city startup failure predate qaRunnerSHA256 capture; their raw reports were not backfilled. Original runner snapshots remain.

The candidate city uses a 360-second active-case wall budget; its complete video also includes loading, UI setup and final evidence collection. Individual 35-second phase timeouts were not enlarged to obtain completion.
The nighttime baseline UI timeout left exposure at 0.87, while the candidate completes the exposure button to 1.02; no full matched-exposure night A/B is claimed.

city.nativeScope: Unedited native WebGL PNGs using the existing camera/weather/exposure/quality UI at 1280x720 DPR1 high. All frames actually viewed. Fixed camera pairs use matching recorded conditions. Driving uses real held W and normal chase; its dwell target is not completed and its pose is not matched across versions. This is street/form evidence, not continuous shadow or performance acceptance.

observations: Crosstown shows actual shelves and objects through the new glass where the baseline has opaque panels and repeated door handles.
Weave entry and the driving view show deeper bookshop/workshop frontages with fewer repeated door handles; the road, awnings and street furniture remain.
Wet-night pairs retain the same recorded exposure 1.02. Local street light pools and wet road reflections remain visible; new display depth is also visible under those lights.
Cross-east gateway remains a wide and sparsely furnished connection; upper occupied-window variation is visible, but tower grids and the distant facades remain simplified.
limits: Before/after telemetry brackets the screenshot and is not an atomic binding to its pixel frame.

Both W requests had a 25 s loop budget. Baseline advanced 0.233333 s before capture and 0.508333 s through the after sample; final advanced 0.316667 s and 0.591667 s, against a 0.8 s target. Screenshot/telemetry overhead extends wall duration and is reported.
The slow SwiftShader captures do not establish hardware GPU frame times, absence of high-refresh flicker, or full-city sustained driving.
Matched fixed night pictures do not repair the separately incomplete/mismatched night driving A/B protocol in shadow-native evidence.
